sources.title: Visa policy index
sources.publisher: Department of Immigration and Passports, Government of Bangladesh
sources.officialityEvidence: The Department of Immigration and Passports publishes this policy index on dip.gov.bd and labels its VOA entry as updated 15 July 2024. The current page exposes a linked VOA document but not a machine-readable ordinary-passport nationality schedule for this residual.

sources.title: Visa on Arrival
sources.publisher: Embassy of the People’s Republic of Bangladesh, Copenhagen
sources.officialityEvidence: This Bangladesh embassy guidance is published on the official mofa.gov.bd domain and states it was updated 25 February 2025. At cross-review it returned a 502 response, and its undefined regional phrase is not treated as an exact current passport-code schedule.
sources.supportingExcerpt: all European Countries are eligible for Visa on Arrival

sources.title: Bangladesh Online MRV Portal
sources.publisher: Department of Immigration and Passports, Government of Bangladesh
sources.officialityEvidence: The footer identifies the Department of Immigration & Passports and Government of Bangladesh.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Take the printed form ... to the nearest Visa office

sources.title: Visa
sources.publisher: Assistant High Commission for the People’s Republic of Bangladesh, Birmingham
sources.officialityEvidence: The current guidance is published on the Bangladesh MFA mission domain and states a foreign-national visa baseline, but does not make an exhaustive nationality, ordinary-passport or exception mapping.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Foreign nationals require a valid visa to enter Bangladesh.

unresolved.reason: Current Bangladesh sources provide positive VOA guidance and a general foreign-national valid-visa statement, but no current exhaustive ordinary-passport mapping identifies this nationality or reconciles visa-free, bilateral, NVR, special-document, and eligible VOA exceptions. The MRV portal is an online form that must be printed and submitted with documents and payment to a visa office or mission; it is not electronic visa issuance. No eVisa, VOA, visa-free, or advance-visa complement is inferred.
